content.p1: Selling is easy, but it requires configuring a few settings. You need to save your trade link in the "Steam trade link" section of your WaxPeer profile.
content.p2: After completing your profile setup, you need to go to the "Sell items" section. If you already have the WaxPeer extension installed, make sure your status is "Online". If you don't have the extension, a window will appear on the page where you can download it, or you can download our app so we can automate trades.
content.p3: Once the extension or app is ready, it will look like the image. (If the extension status says "Please log in to Steam", it means you need to authorize on steamcommunity.com and steampowered.com in your browser). When your "P2P Status" goes online (turns green), you can start selling: select a skin, set its price, and list it on the marketplace.
content.p4: Now you can select the items you want to sell.
content.p5: When setting a price for an item, you can use the slider in the dropdown window to quickly set a suitable and profitable price for each individual item.
content.p6: All your items listed for sale will be located in the "My Shop" section. Here you can track the status of your offers, change their price, or remove them.
content.p7: When someone decides to buy one of your items, you will receive a notification on the website. If you wish, you can link your Discord and/or Telegram in your WaxPeer account settings to receive notifications in these messengers in addition to the website.
content.p8: After someone buys your item, you will need to confirm the trade sent by us through your account. The confirmation will appear in the Steam mobile app under the "Confirmations" section. Once you confirm it, the item will be sent. As soon as the buyer accepts the trade offer containing the item, the funds will be credited to your WaxPeer balance.
content.p9: Please note that you can only sell items that are tradeable (without a trade ban).
